claims: The Chile vs. Cabo Verde match was a 2026 FIFA Series friendly match.
The Chile vs. Cabo Verde match was played on March 26-27, 2026.
The Chile vs. Cabo Verde match was played at Eden Park in Auckland, New Zealand.
Chile overcame a 2-1 halftime deficit against Cabo Verde.
Cabo Verde held a 2-1 lead over Chile at half-time.
Sidny Cabral scored a goal assisted by Dailon Livramento in the first half.
Cabo Verde was a man down in the second half.
The date of the Chile vs. Cabo Verde match was Thursday, March 26, 2026 (local time in Auckland).
The Chile vs. Cabo Verde match was a FIFA Series international friendly match.
The FIFA Series is aimed at fostering competition between teams from different confederations.
